question: $AD$ is a median of $\triangle ABC$. Extend $AD$ to $E$ so that $DE=AD$, and draw $CE$. If $AB=7$, find the length of $CE$.
solution: $BD=CD$, $\angle ADB=\angle EDC$ (vertically opposite angles), and $AD=ED$, so $\triangle ABD\cong\triangle ECD$ (SAS). Thus, $CE=AB=7$.
